author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this personal and powerful talk, Syreeta explores how parenting a neurodivergent child revealed a truth that many leadership models overlook: presence is everything. Not strategy, authority or performance. But the ability to truly meet another human being exactly where they are. Syreeta shows how the same qualities that create safety and growth for a neurodivergent child -  consistency, compassion and deep presence, are the very qualities that unlock trust, innovation and performance within teams and communities. 

Syreeta Brown, author of Bigger than the Moon, is one of the UK’s most influential HR leaders and women in finance. Former Group Chief People & Communications Officer at Virgin Money and previously Managing Director at Citi, Syreeta is among the few Black women to reach the UK’s C-Suite. Named in the UK Powerlist’s top 10 most influential Black Britons, she blends two decades of corporate leadership with lived experience as a mother to a neurodivergent daughter.

title: What autism can teach us about leadership | Syreeta Brown | TEDxRichmond

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Can you read a stranger in six seconds?

Kostya Kimlat has spent 25 years doing exactly that. As a professional magician, his career depends on walking up to people he’s never met and knowing, within moments, how to connect with them. In this talk, he reveals the system behind it. Using a deck of cards and four volunteers from the audience, Kostya demonstrates something most of us get wrong every day: we treat everyone the same and wonder why we don’t connect. His answer takes six seconds and two observations, and reveals how the four suits in a deck of cards map to four ways a person can show up in any moment. By the end, you’ll watch the trick and see four people getting exactly what they need. Kostya Kimlat is a professional magician best known for fooling Penn & Teller on their hit TV show “Fool Us.” He has performed in more than 200 cities across five continents and teaches organizations around the world about perception, communication, and human connection. title: How To Read Anyone In 6 Seconds | Kostya Kimlat | TEDxSarasota

In questo talk, Massimo Sirelli racconta come le sue radici siano diventate il punto di partenza di un viaggio creativo che lo ha portato lontano, senza mai perdere il senso di casa.
Attraverso la sua storia personale, fatta di partenze, ritorni, successi e sfide, riflette sul significato autentico del cambiamento e sul valore di restare fedeli a ciò che ci definisce. Un racconto che mostra come le radici non siano un'ancora che trattiene, ma la forza che permette di volare sempre più lontano. Massimo Sirelli è artista, designer e art director calabrese, tra i protagonisti più interessanti della scena pop e urban art contemporanea. Dopo gli esordi nel mondo dei graffiti negli anni Novanta e la formazione allo IED di Torino, ha sviluppato un percorso multidisciplinare che unisce arte, design, comunicazione e sperimentazione visiva, collaborando
